assumptions: Limit line is assumed marked so stop_line/stop_zone apply; crosswalk and intersecting-roadway-entrance branches are omitted because no geometry is listed for them.
Stop is interpreted as remaining continuously inside stop_zone while stopped for 1000 ms; the statute states only 'shall stop' with no duration.
Stopped is interpreted as max_speed 0.05; the statute gives no speed value.
Inbound crossing toward the intersection (+y) is interpreted as direction to_right per the stop_line definition.
Anchor center is used because boxes are top-down vehicles whose centre is metric position.
Objects that never cross the stop line pass vacuously via IMPLIES.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must first stop in the approach waiting zone before crossing.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
